#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

found=0
for f in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/.github/workflows/*.yml "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    if [ -e "$f" ]; then
        if grep -iqE 'secret[-_]?scanning' "$f"; then
            found=1
            break
        fi
    fi
done

if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
